EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows strong aliphatic C–H stretches at 2885/2941 cm⁻¹ and a single carbonyl near 1741 cm⁻¹ consistent with an ester C=O; candidate 1 (an aliphatic ester) fits this well. Supporting bands include CH bending at 1454 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003) and C–O/C–C fingerprint features near 1037 and 1306 cm⁻¹ typical of esters. No N–H/O–H stretches are present, disfavoring amide/carbamate or alcohol candidates. Other hydrocarbon-only candidates lack a carbonyl, and the thioester/fluoro candidate would more likely shift ν(C=O) lower than 1741 cm⁻¹.
